title.zh: The US Bitcoin reserve faces a crucial bipartisan test Wednesday
title.en: The US Bitcoin reserve faces a crucial bipartisan test Wednesday

current_state.zh: 《美国储备现代化法案》(ARMA, H.R. 8957) 已以 28-21 的投票结果通过众议院金融服务委员会，下一步需经众议院和参议院全体表决后才能递交总统签署。
current_state.en: The American Reserve Modernization Act (ARMA, H.R. 8957) passed the House Financial Services Committee 28-21 and must now pass the full House and Senate before reaching the president's desk.

updates.title_en: The US Bitcoin reserve faces a crucial bipartisan test Wednesday
updates.what_changed_zh: The House Financial Services Committee will mark up the American Reserve Modernization Act (ARMA), which would establish a federal Bitcoin reserve in statute, but the bill has only one Democratic cosponsor who does not sit on the committee.

updates.title_zh: US lawmakers advance bill to lock Trump’s Bitcoin reserve into law
updates.title_en: US lawmakers advance bill to lock Trump’s Bitcoin reserve into law
updates.what_changed_zh: 美国众议院金融服务委员会以 28-21 的投票结果通过了《2026 年美国储备现代化法案》(H.R. 8957)，该法案将把特朗普的战略比特币储备编入法律，并要求联邦没收的比特币至少持有 20 年。
updates.what_changed_en: The House Financial Services Committee passed the American Reserve Modernization Act of 2026 (H.R. 8957) by a 28-21 vote, advancing the bill to codify Trump's strategic Bitcoin reserve and require federally forfeited Bitcoin to be held at least 20 years.
updates.current_state_zh: 《美国储备现代化法案》(ARMA, H.R. 8957) 已以 28-21 的投票结果通过众议院金融服务委员会，下一步需经众议院和参议院全体表决后才能递交总统签署。
updates.current_state_en: The American Reserve Modernization Act (ARMA, H.R. 8957) passed the House Financial Services Committee 28-21 and must now pass the full House and Senate before reaching the president's desk.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The American Reserve Modernization Act of 2026 (H.R. 8957) passed the House Financial Services Committee 28-21, aiming to codify Trump's strategic Bitcoin reserve and lock federally forfeited Bitcoin for 20 years.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The American Reserve Modernization Act of 2026 (H.R. 8957) passed the House Financial Services Committee 28-21, aiming to codify Trump's strategic Bitcoin reserve and lock federally forfeited Bitcoin for 20 years.
